studies.title: Boosting Sales by 35% for a Premium Lifestyle & Gifting Ecommerce Brand with Flutter App
studies.subtitle: Built a high-performance Flutter mobile application with native Stripe & Tabby checkout, real-time Shopify GraphQL sync, and automated push notifications.
studies.challenge: Client struggled with webview checkout redirects causing 68% cart abandonment, non-standard product metafields, and lack of real-time push engagement.
studies.solution: Developed a custom Shopify GraphQL layer, 100% native in-app payments with Stripe and Tabby BNPL, and Firebase push messaging.

studies.title: AI-Powered Fitness Platform
studies.subtitle: Engineered a real-time computer vision and machine learning fitness platform with automated workout tracking and dynamic biomechanical feedback.
studies.challenge: Client struggled with high customer churn and excessive compute costs running heavy computer vision models on mobile clients.
studies.solution: Built an edge-optimized AI inference pipeline, web socket streaming architecture, and scalable Node/Python microservices backend.

studies.title: Enterprise Omnichannel Order Management
studies.subtitle: Unified order capture, warehouse dispatch, and real-time inventory synchronization across 150+ regional retail fulfillment hubs.
studies.challenge: Legacy ERP was dropping orders during flash sale peaks with over 45 seconds of checkout latency.
studies.solution: Implemented distributed event-driven messaging using Apache Kafka and resilient PostgreSQL read replicas.

studies.title: Multi-Tenant B2B Workflow SaaS
studies.subtitle: Refactored a single-tenant monolith into a SOC 2-compliant multi-tenant SaaS platform supporting custom tenant subdomains and role-based ACL.
studies.challenge: High hosting overhead per tenant and inability to ship new features without manual per-customer deployments.
studies.solution: Built isolated tenant schema architecture, automated tenant provisioning pipelines, and automated Stripe billing.

studies.title: High-Concurrency Social & Dating App
studies.subtitle: Built a scalable iOS and Android social discovery application with real-time geolocation matching and encrypted messaging.
studies.challenge: Frequent server timeouts and memory leaks during geo-proximity searches in dense metropolitan zones.
studies.solution: Implemented Redis geospatial indexing, WebRTC voice/video calling, and native React Native architecture.

studies.title: Next-Gen Headless E-Commerce Experience
studies.subtitle: Developed ultra-fast headless digital storefronts integrated with headless Shopify, Algolia search, and one-click localized checkout.
studies.challenge: Slow mobile page load times (5.2s) resulting in an abandoned checkout rate of over 68%.
studies.solution: Modernized to Next.js static site generation with edge caching and instant instant-search filtering.

studies.title: Autonomous Drone Fleet Telemetry Dashboard
studies.subtitle: Created a real-time command-and-control telemetry hub for autonomous agricultural and surveillance drone fleets.
studies.challenge: Handling millions of high-frequency GPS telemetry data points per second with live video stream overlays.
studies.solution: Engineered time-series telemetry pipelines with TimescaleDB, WebGL map layers, and HLS low-latency video streaming.

studies.title: Smart Retail & In-Store Experience App
studies.subtitle: Delivered an omnichannel mobile client featuring AR virtual fitting room, barcode scanner inventory lookup, and loyalty rewards.
studies.challenge: Disconnected in-store physical shopping experiences and low repeat customer engagement.
studies.solution: Engineered cross-platform mobile app with ARKit/ARCore support and real-time POS inventory synchronization.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our enterprise software engineering process, pricing, and support.

items.q: Can you help if we are building software for the first time?
items.a: Yes, absolutely! We guide first-time founders and non-technical stakeholders from initial scoping and wireframing through architecture selection, MVP launch, and scaling.

items.q: How would you know what software solution our business requires?
items.a: Our discovery process begins with an in-depth audit of your current business workflows, bottlenecks, and user goals. We conduct stakeholder interviews and technical feasibility assessments to propose the optimal architecture.

items.q: How long does it take to develop custom software?
items.a: Typical MVPs take between 6 to 12 weeks. Large-scale enterprise systems with extensive integrations generally range from 3 to 6 months. We work in 2-week agile sprints so you see functional progress every sprint.

items.q: Is it possible to build software tailored to our specific business processes?
items.a: Yes. Every line of code, database schema, and interface is custom-engineered around your unique operational rules, permissions, and business logic.

items.q: What technologies do you use for software development?
items.a: We use modern, enterprise-grade stacks including Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, and Kubernetes.

items.q: Can you integrate the software with our current ERP, CRM, or other systems?
items.a: Yes, we have deep experience integrating with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, HubSpot, Stripe, QuickBooks, custom legacy databases, and REST/GraphQL APIs.

items.q: Do you develop software for startups, SMEs, and enterprises?
items.a: Yes, we tailor our delivery approach for early-stage startups needing rapid time-to-market as well as high-growth SMEs and enterprises requiring strict compliance and high throughput.

items.q: What software development engagement models do you offer?
items.a: We provide Staff Augmentation, Dedicated Engineering Pods, Fixed-Scope Project Delivery, and Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) models.

items.q: Can you modernize our existing legacy software?
items.a: Yes, we specialize in legacy migration, cloud refactoring, monolithic-to-microservices modernization, and frontend revamps with zero downtime.

items.q: How do you ensure software quality, security, and performance?
items.a: We employ automated CI/CD testing, static code analysis, OWASP security audits, end-to-end automated testing, and comprehensive load testing.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance and support after software launch?
items.a: Yes, we provide 24/7 SLA-backed support, security patching, infrastructure monitoring, and continuous feature enhancements.

items.q: Will we own the source code and intellectual property?
items.a: Yes, 100%. All source code, assets, and intellectual property are transferred completely to you upon project milestone completion.
